# West Byfleet Social Club

> A members' social club at 41 Station Approach, West Byfleet, Surrey, KT14 6NE, next to West Byfleet railway station. Offers snooker, pool, darts, bingo, quiz nights and live music for members, and hires out its function room to the public for birthdays, weddings and engagement parties, funerals and wakes, christenings, and community or corporate events.

Key facts: phone 01932 346240, email secretary@westbyfleetsocial.com. Opening hours: Monday-Thursday 2pm-11pm, Friday 2pm-11.30pm, Saturday 12pm-11.30pm, Sunday 12pm-10.30pm. Free on-site parking and step-free access. No membership is required to hire the function room.

- [Membership](https://www.westbyfleetsocial.com/membership.html): how to join, cost, and what membership includes.

- [Food & Drink](https://www.westbyfleetsocial.com/food-and-drink.html): Sunday roast, Saturday lunch, sandwiches and the Friday evening menu, with prices.
